Grit mazboot hai.
Himmat dar ke khilaf muqawamat hai.
Saahas dar ka virodh hai, dar par kabu hai - dar ki anupasthiti nahi.
Meaningful goal ke liye discomfort choose karna—grit.
Himmat greatness ki chingari hai.
Smooth sea se skilled sailor nahi banta.
Grit luck nahi; kaam hai.
Himmat phir se khade hona hai.
Grit rukavaton ko paar karti hai.
Courage decide karta: fear future decide nahi karega.
Chuppi mann ka mandir hai.
Khamoshi thoughts ke beech ki jagah hai.
Kiye gaye chhote kaam un badi yojnaon se behtar hain jo sirf soche gaye hain.
Bahadur hona: afraid hoke bhi move.
Strength tab paida hoti jab lagta—bas nahi.
Courage aur perseverance ka magical talisman—jis ke aage mushkile gayab.
Shaant mann sab saaf dekhta hai.
Chup rehna gyaan ki shuruat hai.
